Timeline Ltd. was an American game company that produced role-playing games and game supplements.
History
Timeline Ltd. published the roleplaying game (RPG), The Morrow Project (1980), and more than a dozen supplements and adventures, including Operation Lucifer (1982), and The Starnaman Incident (1984). They also published the time travel RPG,  Time & Time Again (1984),  and a single supplement, Holy Warriors (1085).
